title: Perplexity AI Chat
description: A full-stack AI chat application that combines conversational AI with web search. Users can create and revisit conversations, get AI-generated chat titles, and view responses in a clean, Markdown-enabled interface.
whyBuilt: To make AI-assisted research and everyday problem-solving accessible through a simple chat experience, with web search and persistent conversation history built in.
features: AI-powered conversations using Google Gemini
Internet search integration for up-to-date information
Separate conversations with generated chat titles
Persistent chat history stored in MongoDB
Create, open, and delete conversations
Markdown-rendered AI responses
Email and password registration and login
Google OAuth sign-in
Protected chat dashboard and user session handling
Responsive chat interface with mobile-friendly navigation

title: Snitch — E-commerce Marketplace
description: A full-stack shopping platform where customers can browse products, choose variants, manage a cart, and pay online. Sellers can create and manage product listings through a protected dashboard.
whyBuilt: To create a complete online shopping experience that brings product discovery, seller tools, cart management, and secure online payments together in one application.
features: Browse and search the product collection
Sort products by newest and price
View product details, images, and available variants
Register and sign in with email and password
Sign in with Google OAuth
Separate buyer and seller roles
Protected seller dashboard for managing listings
Create product listings with multiple images
Add product variants with attributes, images, prices, and stock
Add products to a cart and update item quantities
Check product stock when managing cart items
Pay through Razorpay checkout
Verify payments on the backend and save payment records
View an order-success page after checkout
Store user, product, cart, and payment data in MongoDB
Use cookie-based JWT sessions with Redis-backed token revocation
Responsive shopping and seller interfaces

title: KHATABOOK
description: Khatabook is a simple yet powerful bookkeeping application built with Node.js and Express. It allows users to record, update, and track financial transactions and balances using the Node.js file system for storage instead of a database.
whyBuilt: To practice backend fundamentals using Node.js and Express, exploring how to store and manage data locally through the file system without relying on external databases
features: Add, update, and delete transaction records
Store data locally in JSON files
RESTful API architecture
Lightweight backend without any database
Middleware for request validation and error handling

readmeHighlights.envSetup: You don't need to set up environment variables for API keys and database connections
